name: Batch 23 · Voices, riffs and movement
status: Published to separate Spotify audition and atomically appended to hosted Playlist Lab. Thirty exact unrated candidates, prior feedback/history preservation and unchanged main Spotify orders verified.

selection_policy.authorization: Host asks to check Grove22 feedback and do another batch of 30. Both remaining Likes and targeted discovery allowed; no predictive model.
selection_policy.method: Editorial selection against all 132 canonical Grove Keeps and 860 Cuts. Grove22 retained Back It Up, Lost In The Rhythm, St. James Ballroom and Happy; eleven Cuts remain authoritative, without invented causal reasons. Each new recording has a positive and rejected comparison and independent text/version context.
selection_policy.brief: Upbeat, interesting, bouncy, melodic, sexy, fun, happy, hopeful and loving; personality, strong hooks and development. Avoid acid/techno, chart-pop/top-five-hit character, sad/negative narrative, blandness, dragging repetition, standalone fragments and artist/album concentration. Preserve every individual Keep.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: No direct audio input supported; musical fit and development remain editorial hypotheses. Published text/source screens are not exact-master transcriptions or complete sample audits. Two instrumentals identified separately; no fabricated listening scores.
selection_policy.source: Targeted discovery. Historical saved-pool cache considered privately; no current Like membership claimed.

feedback_basis.policy: Canonical shared feedback resolves host priority; preserve individual histories
